heroHeadline: Day 4,875: BTS's Santiago Estadio Nacional Run Has Ended
heroSubtitle: October 18, 2026 is Day 4,875 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. The ARIRANG World Tour's three Santiago Estadio Nacional nights (Oct 14, 16, 17) were scheduled to be complete, the group's first Chile shows since 2017; independent post-show reports are not yet available.
